1 TENDER ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: [a] The bidder with past performance of satisfactory execution of contracts to SCo Railw ay/Other Zonal Railways/PUs/Central Govt/State Govt/PSUs for supply of the same / simil ar items for a quantity of 20 percent or more of tendered quantity against a single contra ct during last three years prior to, and excluding tender opening date shall be considere d as responsive to SCo Railways requirements for placement of bulk and regular order. b idders are requested to submit the past performance report such as Copies of R Notes/C RAC/Proof of acceptance of material by consignee etc. along with their offer; failing whic h offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. SIMILAR ITEM: Any type of Self propelled battery operated scissor lif t [b] In case, the bidder participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as re quired above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authorizing the agent or bidder for the sam e OEM. It may so happen that the agent/dealer has credentials of past supply for a differ ent Principal/OEM, then it will not be considered as performance. For Authorised dealers, tender specific authorization from OEM has to be uploaded with bid. 2 Clause wise compliance of the tendered specifications attached must be submitted alon g with the bid duly signed by the bidders. Failure to do so will result in summary rejectio n of the offer. 3 Minor deviations from tendered specifications shall be acceptable (except where expres sly prohibited) subject to such deviations does not adversely affect the performance of t he machine in intended use. 4 Payment Terms: The standard payment terms subject to recoveries, if any, under the liquidated damages clause and general condition of contract will be as under:- 100% payment will be made after receipt, installation/commissioning and acceptance of the material by the consignee. Note: Bill passing officer to ensure the validity of PBG/WSD to cover warranty obligations as per contract before passing final bill. 5 Other conditions: 1. Supplier Responsibility: The supplier shall be solely responsible for the safe delivery o f the Battery Operated scissor type areal lifters the designated consignee locations. 2. Unloading Arrangement: All arrangements for unloading the equipment from the tran sport vehicle (including hiring of cranes, ramps, or specialized labour) shall be made by the supplier at their own cost and risk.Unloading Locations: Coaching Depot, Guntur (SC oR) and Freight Depot, Nallapadu (SCoR)

3. Pre-Installation Requirements: Advance notification at least 15 days prior to the expe cted delivery date, the supplier must provide a written document detailing the "Pre-Com missioning Checklist. “The document must clearly state the facilities required from the R ailways for successful installation, such as: Specific power supply/socket type for chargi ng units, required floor levelling/clearance for initial testing, storage space for manuals a nd specialized tools. 4. . Commissioning & Performance Testing: Commissioning must be performed by OEM authorized or OEM technical representatives at both the Coaching Depot (Guntur) and Fr eight Depot (Nallapadu). 5. Load Testing: The supplier must demonstrate the machine's performance under rated load and verify all safety interlocks, including the Active Pothole Protection and Emergen cy Descent System. 6. Final Acceptance: The equipment will be considered "commissioned" only after a Joint Inspection Report (JIR) is signed by the Railway's representative and the supplier’s repre sentative after fulfilment of all conditions. 7. Technical Documentation :**Each unit must be supplied with a comprehensive docum entation kit (in English) including: a. Operator’s Manual: For safe daily usage and controls. b. Maintenance Manual: Detailing lubrication schedules (bushings/kingpins) and hydrauli c system care. c. Troubleshooting Guide: Specific to the MDI (Ground Display) error codes for the unit.. d. Illustrated Spare Parts List (ISPL): To facilitate easy identification of components for fu ture procurement. 8. Training Program: The supplier shall conduct a structured training program at both de pots for Railway staff: a. Operation Training: Hands-on training for operators on proportional controls, platform extension, and navigating narrow aisles. b. Maintenance Training: Instruction for technical staff on battery electrolyte manageme nt, charging cycles, and emergency manual lowering. c. Troubleshooting: Training on using the on-board diagnostic port and interpreting the V ariable Tilt Visual Indicator. 9. Service Support and On-site Repair Services: The supplier shall ensure the availability of service engineers to attend to machine brea kdown complaints at both consignee locations, i.e., Coaching Depot, Guntur (SCoR) and Freight Depot, Nallapadu (SCoR). The supplier shall also provide on-site repair services a nd necessary spare parts for any breakdowns, including after the warranty period, with a priority response time of 24–48 hours from the time of intimation.

10. The supplier shall submit a quotation for the Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) for the equipment after the expiry of the warranty period. 6. Penalty Clause: 1. After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty pe riod, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 7 days time limit (or as specified in other terms in contract). 2. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification within the defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each w eek of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such shall be charged as penalty or recover all such penalty amount from the Warranty Performance Security (WPBG) for each week of delay from the seller. 3. Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 5% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alt ernate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cost of such service /get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 4. Bad performance in supply/warranty obligations etc. in this contract shall be reco rded and duly taken into consideration while taking decision in future tenders issu ed from Indian Railways. Bad performance shall include, but not limited to, failure to honour timelines/ conditions specified in contract, PO cancellation on suppliers account, repeated DP extension, poor warranty/AMC support etc. 7 Consignee Details (For delivery and payment matters): Ph no. SSE- 9701379463 Delivery details: The Supplier shall deliver the materials to the designated consignee locations mentioned below. a. Coaching Depot, Guntur.(SSE/C&W/GNT).Near Guntur Railway station. b. Freight Examination Depot,Nallapadu (SSE/C&W/NLPD) .Near nallapadu railway statio n. The equipment is to be delivered to: Depot In-charge or authorised railway representative (SSE), Freight Examination Depot, Nallapadu, Opp Nallapadu Railway Station, Guntur Division, South coast Railway.The supplier shall coord inate with the depot in-charge prior to dispatch to confirm the exact delivery point and u nloading area Other Conditions: *** .

In case my/our claim to exemption from submission of bid security/ Earnest Money Dep osit is not found valid as per terms of the tender, I/we understand and accept that Railw ays has unquestionable right to summarily reject my bid and my offer shall not be consi dered for ordering.
